(sec-exudyn-cutilities)=
# exudyn.cUtilities

The submodule `exudyn.cUtilities` gives Python the kinematics functions of the C++ code of Exudyn: rotation matrices, Euler parameters, Tait-Bryan angles, rotation vectors, skew matrices and basis vectors. They compute with the math functions of `exudyn.cMath` and give the same bits on every platform. `exudyn.rigidBodyUtilities` calls them under the same names; the documentation there says which. A vector is given as list or numpy array, also of shape (3,1) or (1,3); a matrix as list of lists or numpy array; the result is a numpy array. A wrong size raises a `ValueError`.

Usage: `import exudyn.cUtilities as cu` and `cu.RotationMatrixZ(0.1)`. The functions are:
- **`ComputeOrthonormalBasisVectors(vector0)`**: the normalized vector0 and two normals to it, as the rows of a 3x3 array (unpacked as [v0, n1, n2] = ...); the normals are not unique; for vector0 = [0,0,0] the rows are vector0 and the x and y axes; computed by EXUmath::ComputeOrthogonalBasisVectors of the C++ code
- **`ComputeOrthonormalBasis(vector0)`**: the rotation matrix whose columns are the rows of ComputeOrthonormalBasisVectors(vector0): the first column is parallel to vector0; computed by EXUmath::ComputeOrthogonalBasisVectors of the C++ code
- **`GramSchmidt(vector0, vector1)`**: the normalized vector0, the normalized part of vector1 normal to vector0, and their cross product, as the rows of a 3x3 array; zero or parallel vectors raise a ValueError; computed by GramSchmidt of PyCUtilities.h of the C++ code
- **`Skew(vector)`**: the skew symmetric 3x3 matrix of a 3D vector, which gives the cross product: Skew(a) @ b = a x b; for a vector of 3n components the n skew matrices one below the other (3n x 3); for a matrix of 3n rows and m columns the skew matrices of its columns side by side (3n x 3m), as needed for the floating frame of reference formulation; computed by Skew of PyCUtilities.h of the C++ code
- **`Skew2Vec(skew)`**: the vector of a skew symmetric 3x3 matrix; for a 4x4 matrix of the Lie algebra se(3) the 6 values [u, w], u the translational part (last column) and w the vector of the skew part; computed by Skew2Vec of PyCUtilities.h of the C++ code
- **`EulerParameters2G(eulerParameters)`**: the 3x4 matrix G of Euler parameters, $\tomega = \Gm \dot \pv$ with the global angular velocity; computed by RigidBodyMath::EP2G of the C++ code
- **`EulerParameters2GLocal(eulerParameters)`**: the 3x4 matrix G of Euler parameters for the local (body-fixed) angular velocity, $\LU{b}{\tomega} = \LU{b}{\Gm} \dot \pv$; computed by RigidBodyMath::EP2Glocal of the C++ code
- **`EulerParameters2RotationMatrix(eulerParameters)`**: the rotation matrix of 4 Euler parameters; computed by RigidBodyMath::EP2RotationMatrix of the C++ code
- **`RotationMatrix2EulerParameters(rotationMatrix)`**: the 4 Euler parameters of a rotation matrix, normalized, so that an inaccurate rotation matrix gives unit Euler parameters; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotationMatrix2EP of the C++ code
- **`AngularVelocity2EulerParameters_t(angularVelocity, eulerParameters)`**: the time derivative of the Euler parameters from the global angular velocity, $\dot \pv = \frac{1}{4}\Gm\tp \tomega$, for unit Euler parameters; computed by RigidBodyMath::EP2G of the C++ code
- **`RotationVector2RotationMatrix(rotationVector)`**: the rotation matrix of a rotation vector, the same as NodeRigidBodyRotVecLG computes; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotationVector2RotationMatrix of the C++ code
- **`RotationMatrix2RotationVector(rotationMatrix)`**: the rotation vector of a rotation matrix, with an angle in [0, pi]; computed by EXUlie::LogSO3Vector of the C++ code
- **`ComputeRotationAxisFromRotationVector(rotationVector)`**: the unit rotation axis of a rotation vector; zero for the zero vector; computed by EXUlie::RotationVector2RotationAxis of the C++ code
- **`ExpSO3(rotationVector)`**: the exponential map of the Lie group SO(3): the rotation matrix of a rotation vector, computed with the sinc function; computed by EXUlie::ExpSO3 of the C++ code
- **`LogSO3(rotationMatrix)`**: the logarithmic map of the Lie group SO(3): the skew symmetric matrix of the rotation vector of a rotation matrix; computed by EXUlie::LogSO3 of the C++ code
- **`RotXYZ2RotationMatrix(rot)`**: the rotation matrix of the Tait-Bryan angles rot = [rotX, rotY, rotZ] (in radians), A = Ax*Ay*Az; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotXYZ2RotationMatrix of the C++ code
- **`RotationMatrix2RotXYZ(rotationMatrix)`**: the Tait-Bryan angles [rotX, rotY, rotZ] of a rotation matrix; at the singularity rotY = pi/2, -pi/2, ... rotX is set 0; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotationMatrix2RotXYZ of the C++ code
- **`RotXYZ2G(rot)`**: the 3x3 matrix G of Tait-Bryan angles, $\LU{0}{\tomega} = \Gm \dot \ttheta$ with the global angular velocity; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotXYZ2GTemplate of the C++ code
- **`RotXYZ2G_t(rot, rot_t)`**: the time derivative of RotXYZ2G, for the angles rot and their time derivatives rot_t; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotXYZ2G_tTemplate of the C++ code
- **`RotXYZ2GLocal(rot)`**: the 3x3 matrix G of Tait-Bryan angles for the local (body-fixed) angular velocity, $\LU{b}{\tomega} = \LU{b}{\Gm} \dot \ttheta$; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotXYZ2GlocalTemplate of the C++ code
- **`RotXYZ2GLocal_t(rot, rot_t)`**: the time derivative of RotXYZ2GLocal, for the angles rot and their time derivatives rot_t; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotXYZ2Glocal_tTemplate of the C++ code
- **`AngularVelocity2RotXYZ_t(angularVelocity, rotation)`**: the time derivative of the Tait-Bryan angles rotation from the global angular velocity; a ValueError at the singularity, |cos(rotation[1])| < 1e-14; computed by RigidBodyMath::AngularVelocity2RotXYZ_t of the C++ code
- **`RotXYZ2EulerParameters(alpha)`**: the 4 Euler parameters of the Tait-Bryan angles alpha, see [Henderson1977]; entry 0 is the scalar part; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotXYZ2EP of the C++ code
- **`RotationMatrix2RotZYZ(rotationMatrix, flip = False)`**: the Euler angles [Z, Y, Z] (in radians) of a rotation matrix, A = Az*Ay*Az; flip chooses the first angle in quadrant 2 or 3; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotationMatrix2RotZYZ of the C++ code
- **`RotationMatrixX(angleRad)`**: the rotation matrix of a rotation by angleRad (in radians) about the x-axis; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotationMatrixX of the C++ code
- **`RotationMatrixY(angleRad)`**: the rotation matrix of a rotation by angleRad (in radians) about the y-axis; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotationMatrixY of the C++ code
- **`RotationMatrixZ(angleRad)`**: the rotation matrix of a rotation by angleRad (in radians) about the z-axis; computed by RigidBodyMath::RotationMatrixZ of the C++ code
- **`RotationMatrix2D(angleRad)`**: the 2x2 rotation matrix of a rotation by angleRad (in radians) in the plane; computed by RotationMatrix2D of PyCUtilities.h of the C++ code
